caption:
Add a 60 here. Does the median move?

The mean jumps from 18 to 22.2, but the two middle values of the new list are still 18 and 18.

Save this for test day.
tiktok_caption: Add a 60 here. Does the median move? The mean jumps. The median doesn't.
